recipeNutriShare.description: RecipeNutriShare is a recipe-sharing app that allows users to create and upload recipes while using a nutrition API to automatically gather and present nutrition information of the recipe.

gamerTalk.description: An application that allows gamers to connect with each other with the goal of building connections.

sustainabilityPage.description: Sustainability Page provides a platform for businesses to centralize their sustainability information in an easy to understand and transparent way to increase stakeholder trust and engagement.
